# Host contamination map, FOCUSED P ASSESSMENT (80482e6), not gate D evidence, generated by tools/contamination.py from the run's own logs

Known external load (coordinator): none reported

Method: WS-B3 host-contamination mapping (coordinator request 2026-11-05). Reads only the run's own logs; does not touch evidence. Per 30-s sample: host busy cores (load.log cpu_busy% x 8, the same 2-s /proc/stat snapshot as c10dd3d), benchmark cores (docker stats ws-*-pg + ws-*-gate, nearest sample within 30 s), non-benchmark cores = host - benchmark, load1, and steal (mpstat %steal, max over +-15 s). Same metric computed on the c10dd3d run (bench2 logs) as the quiet reference. A sample is FLAGGED when (A) non-benchmark cores > the c10dd3d p95 of the same metric in this sample AND its neighbour (sustained >= ~1 min; single-sample spikes of the estate baseline, e.g. GitLab, are not flagged), or (B) load1 > max(1.25 x, +3 over) the c10dd3d maximum for the same scenario name (CHOSEN/REFERENCE only; PARTITIONED has no c10dd3d counterpart). A scenario is NOT REPRESENTATIVE when its [start, done] interval overlaps the known external window or contains a flagged sample.

## Every window with load1 > 15.1 (the c10dd3d p90), with attribution
Attribution rule: inside the known external window -> EXTERNAL (known); else FLAGGED by A/B -> NOT EXPLAINED by the benchmark;
